title: Audit export filtering engine: include/exclude by event_type, actor, resource, environment (w/ validation + safe defaults)
creator: Ethan Park
description:
Goal
Build the filtering engine used by the audit-export delivery worker to decide whether a given audit event should be exported to a destination. Filters must be expressive enough for beta customers to reduce noise/cost, but safe and predictable (validation, explicit failure states, and no “surprise drops”).

Context / links
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/siem-ready-audit-export-beta-prd.json
- Design spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/audit-export-filtering-and-delivery-guarantees.json
- Schema v1: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-event-schema-v1.json

Scope
1) Filter model + semantics
- Support rules in config per destination:
  - event_type: include / exclude list (exact match), plus optional prefix match for namespaces (e.g., "rbac.*") if we can guarantee stable taxonomy.
  - actor: include / exclude by actor.type (user|service_account|api_key), actor.id, and optionally actor.email (exact match).
  - resource: include / exclude by resource.type and resource.id.
  - environment: include list (prod|staging|dev) and allow explicit “unknown”.
- Semantics: deny takes precedence over allow (i.e., exclude rules override include rules). If includes are specified for a dimension, event must match at least one include in that dimension. If includes are omitted for a dimension, that dimension is treated as “match all” (subject to excludes).
- Missing fields: treat as non-match for includes; for excludes, only exclude if the field is present and matches (avoid dropping due to absent data).

2) Validation + safe defaults
- Validation happens in control plane at destination create/update (ENG-13921) and is re-validated in worker startup before applying (defense in depth).
- Validate:
  - event_type values must be known (backed by schema registry / taxonomy list from ENG-13927). If taxonomy list isn’t available at runtime, validate format and warn; do not silently accept obviously invalid patterns.
  - actor.type and environment enums.
  - resource.type allowlist (from schema) if available.
  - size limits: max rules per destination and max total values per dimension (protect worker perf and config abuse).
  - “contradictions” warning (same value in both include and exclude) -> reject with clear error.
- Safe defaults for beta:
  - If customer provides no filter rules, export ALL audit events (do not default to a partial subset).
  - Console should provide recommended templates (handled in DES/Console tickets); engine just implements semantics.

3) Performance / operability
- Engine should compile filter config to an efficient predicate (hash sets for exact matches; avoid regex in beta).
- Must not allocate per event beyond minimal lookups; target < 50µs per event evaluation at p95 in worker.
- Add debug counters/metrics:
  - events_filtered_total{destination_id,reason} where reason is one of: event_type_excluded, actor_excluded, resource_excluded, env_excluded, missing_required_field, invalid_event_schema.
- Add structured log for “config rejected” and “config applied” with destination_id + config_version.

Out of scope (beta)
- Full boolean expression language (AND/OR groups, negation beyond excludes).
- Regex matching for actor/resource IDs.
- Cross-field rules (e.g., “exclude if event_type=X and actor.type=service_account”).

Acceptance criteria
- Unit tests cover:
  - Include-only, exclude-only, and mixed include+exclude.
  - Precedence (exclude overrides include).
  - Missing fields behavior.
  - Size limits and invalid enums.
  - Unknown event_type handling behavior matches agreed policy (reject vs warn).
- Integration tests in exporter repo demonstrate:
  - Filtered events do not reach sink connectors.
  - “Filtered count” metrics increment with correct reason.
- Control plane rejects invalid filters with actionable error messages (field path + reason) and does not persist invalid config.

Implementation notes
- Shared library: prefer implementing filtering logic in audit-log-exporter (worker) as a package that can be reused by control plane for validation to avoid semantic drift. If we can’t share code across repos, we must write a conformance test suite with golden cases consumed by both.
- Versioning: filter config should carry a “filter_version” (start at v1) so we can evolve semantics without ambiguity.

Risks / open questions
- Taxonomy stability: do we have a canonical list of event_type strings for validation at config-time? If not, we should validate structure only (e.g., "namespace.action"), and rely on schema_version + docs.
- Prefix match for event_type: helpful for customers, but introduces ambiguity and future-compat issues; propose exact match only for beta unless Security approves wildcard rules.
- Email matching for actor: PII concerns; if we support it, ensure we’re matching on redacted/normalized value (or disallow by default and require explicit enable).

Owner checklist
- [ ] Align final semantics with Naomi + Marcus/Kevin (Security Eng) and update design spec section on filtering.
- [ ] Land worker-side implementation + tests.
- [ ] Land control-plane validation logic + errors returned to Console.
- [ ] Add metrics and wire to dashboards (ENG-13931).

Related work
- Worker queue/retry semantics: ENG-13923
- Destination CRUD + config model: ENG-13921
- Schema publication/taxonomy: ENG-13927
- Exporter implementation PR reference (likely): sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr_0159.json
comments: 2025-02-06 — Naomi Feldman: Please ensure we don’t default to a subset of events. Customer expectation is: if they enable export and don’t touch filters, they get everything (subject to schema redaction). Console can recommend templates, but the backend default should be “export all”.

2025-02-10 — Marcus Lin: Agree on exclude-precedence. For beta, avoid regex/wildcards unless we can bound CPU and clearly document forward-compat risk. Also be careful with actor.email filtering; that can encourage customers to depend on emails in logs for correlation. Prefer actor.id when possible.
2025-02-12 — Rafael Mendes: +1 on metrics by filter reason. We need to distinguish “filtered by config” vs “dropped due to invalid schema” in dashboards and in incident triage.

2025-02-18 — Chloe Martin: Console UX will likely present: (a) environment selector, (b) event type multiselect, (c) actor type toggle. Please keep config shape stable and include good error paths so we can show inline validation errors in the UI.
updates: 2025-02-14 — Diego Santos: Drafted predicate compilation approach (hash sets, no regex). Proposed config shape includes filter_version=v1 and dimensions {event_type, actor, resource, environment}. Pending decision on event_type wildcard support.

2025-02-21 — Diego Santos: Implemented worker-side filter eval in audit-log-exporter behind feature flag. Added counters for filtered reasons. Next: control-plane validation and conformance tests to prevent drift.

2025-03-01 — Diego Santos: Added size limits (max 200 values total across all dimensions per destination) and contradiction checks. Open: final policy for unknown event_type (reject at config-time vs warn). Scheduling quick sync with Security + PM.
